strips.title: The night the power goes out — with the Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2

panels.head: 9:12 PM — lights out
panels.text: You carry it to the kitchen in one hand. 25 pounds, no fumes, no noise.

panels.head: Fridge + Wi-Fi + phones
panels.text: 2,000 W starts the compressor without a hiccup. The router never blinks.

panels.head: 7 AM — grid back for an hour
panels.text: You plug it in. 49 minutes later it's full again, before the power drops a second time.

panels.head: Day 3: the milk is still cold
panels.text: The review owners write most: "I should have bought this years ago."
